name: 34786 · Windermere, FL
findings: ZIP 34786 (Windermere) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34786 (Windermere) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34786 (Windermere) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.
